about.title: About Base64 Encoding
about.whatIsDescription: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that represents binary data in an ASCII string format. It's commonly used when there's a need to encode binary data that needs to be stored and transferred over media that are designed to deal with text.

uses.embedding: Embedding images in HTML, CSS, or JSON
uses.email: Sending binary data through email systems
uses.storage: Storing complex data in simple text formats
